_comment: A recipe makes the piece at S1 and at its perfect roll from: the plain (non-stasified) piece,
the piece's own game recipe scaled by ingredientFactor (or, for a piece no recipe makes, the
essence x formulaEssenceFactor), the guardian essence of its level band, and the service cost
max(costMinimum, costPerLevel x level) in kamas-calibrated Orbes (paid in Jondo Coins in coin mode).
Legendary Fissure recipes: pieces of legendary.fromLevel+ asked «S2» give S2, need Fissure
fragments (17274, the Abîme's) and cost x costFactor. The gauge does not lower the cost.
Overrides win over the generated recipe: { result, tier, ingredients:[{item,quantity}], cost, noEssence }.
Essences: one real resource per level band, dropped by a dungeon boss of that band (MonsterTemplates drops).

essences.why: Robo para tontos, Refugio Silvestre's boss (7197)
Hoja de blop real, the four Royal Blops (1184-1187)
Bigote de Klim, Sala Privada de Klim (3384)
